rule.cut_iff: no positive fixture breaks; no demonstrated detection is demoted; the cue's own PTC lift interval does not clear 1; no read span carried the construct by EITHER reader; and the cue is benign-ubiquitous (>= ptc_bg_min occurrences in the unannotated PTC background, or >= bg_min_occurrences in the general-prose pool) or marked defective
rule.replace_iff: the cut rule holds for the generic form AND every added cue is in the detection's gold text AND is not itself benign-ubiquitous
rule.exclude_iff: >= exclude_min_read read spans (cue-only or quoted) attest the false-fire pattern; the exclusion silences no span either reader marked construct-present; no fixture breaks; no demonstrated detection is demoted
rule.note: IDENTICAL rule and thresholds to CUE-REPAIR-2026-09-07.json -- see PREREG-2026-09-08-shoptalk-corpus.md. The only thing that changed is the general-prose pool, which now includes corpus/ai-governance-shoptalk.jsonl (46 docs / ~137 kwords, declared background/recomputable in background_rate.py ROLES). Nothing about the rule is loosened or tuned to this corpus's content.
